import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive visualization with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_data = df.copy()
sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=60)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
top_occupations = occupation_sleep.tail(8)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(top_occupations))
top_occupations.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax2, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by\nOccupation (Top 8)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=8)

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level with Sleep Quality heatmap
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], s=df['Daily Steps']/50, 
                     alpha=0.6, cmap='RdYlGn', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level\n(Color: Sleep Quality, Size: Daily Steps)', 
             fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(bmi_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(9)
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Sleep Duration Distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df.boxplot(column='Sleep Duration', by='Gender', ax=ax5, patch_artist=True)
ax5.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Sleep Duration by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.sca(ax5)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
ax5.get_figure().suptitle('')

# 6. Heart Rate vs Age colored by Stress Level
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
scatter2 = ax6.scatter(df['Age'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='coolwarm', 
                      alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax6.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Age by Stress', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar2 = plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=ax6)
cbar2.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=9)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Correlation between Sleep Quality and Daily Steps
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
bins = [0, 3000, 5000, 7000, 10000, 15000]
labels = ['0-3k', '3-5k', '5-7k', '7-10k', '10k+']
df['Steps_Category'] = pd.cut(df['Daily Steps'], bins=bins, labels=labels)
steps_quality = df.groupby('Steps_Category', observed=True)['Quality of Sleep'].mean()
colors_bar = sns.color_palette('Blues_d', len(steps_quality))
steps_quality.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color=colors_bar, edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_xlabel('Daily Steps Range', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_ylabel('Avg Sleep Quality', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_title('Sleep Quality vs\nDaily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
            fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
